- Problem: implement a compact KV cache with TTL and O(1) read/write under concurrent access; follow-up: analyze latency under 2x load.
- Candidate: clean, systematic approach; used simple lock-free sketch and explained trade-offs clearly.

- System design / perf reasoning: 4/5 (good latency analysis, suggested sharding approach).
- Coding speed & clarity: 3/5 (typical for candidate coming from infra role; needed one hint to finish tests).

Accessibility / logistics note: Avery asked for a 5-minute mic check pre-call; Tessa confirmed the tech-check and noted no ongoing issues.

1) Marcus: upload notes + consolidated rubric to GDrive and link to candidate ATS record — will do by EOD.
2) Recruiting (Patrick): collect references and coordinate loop if we move forward.
3) Team: if no objections, propose 1–2 follow-up coding tasks or an onsite systems deep-dive. Please reply with any red flags within 24 hours.
